content2.content: A widget that animates between values without needing an AnimationController. Best for simple and one-time animations.

content5.content: AnimationController controls animation playback. It requires TickerProvider to sync with screen refresh rate (vsync). Always dispose the controller.

content7.content: Tweens map values during animation (e.g., 0 to 100). CurvedAnimation applies easing (easeIn, easeOut, bounce, etc.) to improve animation smoothness.

content9.content: Implicit animations (e.g., AnimatedContainer) animate automatically when values change. Explicit animations use AnimationController for full control.

content11.content: Multiple animations run sequentially using different intervals. Useful for onboarding screens and complex UI animations.

content13.content: Helps animate between widgets when they change. Supports fade, scale, slide and custom transitions.

content15.content: Used to animate position changes inside Stack or Align without creating manual animations.

content17.content: Enables smooth shared element transitions between screens using the same hero tag.

content19.content: Allows animating drawings like charts, graphs, waves, circular indicators, and loaders using Canvas.

content21.content:
• Use AnimatedBuilder to reduce rebuilds.
• Wrap complex widgets in RepaintBoundary.
• Avoid unnecessary setState.
• Cache images and heavy objects.
• Use implicit animations for simple effects.
